title: 认识化学品的危害：SDS与标签
source_doc: course/Chemical Spillage & Response/04_Chemical Hazards Lab Safety Video Part 4.md
author_source: project/Chemical Spillage & Response/04_Chemical Hazards Lab Safety Video Part 4/src.py

points.K7: 第1–3部分：是什么、有何危险
points.K15: 象形图各代表什么危害
points.S1: 国内标准：中文SDS和中文标签
points.S2: 信号词只有“危险”和“警告”
points.S4: 自配、分装的试剂也要贴标签
points.S5: 认出特殊管控的化学品

shots.scene: 欣欣站在化学试剂柜旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed chemical reagent cabinet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，学会认清化学品的危害。
overlay: 认识化学品的危害：SDS与标签

shots.scene: 一本空白说明书和一只贴着象形图的试剂瓶并排
shots.prompt_en: A thick blank document binder next to a reagent bottle with a blank label and one GHS red diamond hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 两件法宝：说明书和标签。

shots.scene: 阿杰从柜里拿出一瓶陌生试剂，准备直接倒
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes an unfamiliar reagent bottle from a cabinet and is about to open it at the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿到一瓶没用过的试剂，就想开工。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着瓶上的红色菱形图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at the red diamond GHS pictogram on the bottle label.
shots.narration: 小研问：它有什么危险，你知道吗？

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 用之前，先弄清它的危害。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶旁出现火焰、压力表、两瓶混合三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with three icons beside it: a flame for high heat, a pressure gauge, and two bottles pouring together. No people.
shots.narration: 很多化学品本身就有潜在危险。

shots.scene: 两瓶液体混合处冒出黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Two beakers pouring into one flask with a yellow warning triangle popping above it. No people.
shots.narration: 遇到高温、高压或彼此混合，更危险。

shots.scene: 欣欣一手举空白文件夹，一手举试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank binder in one paw and a labeled reagent bottle with a blank label in the other.
shots.narration: 识别危害，靠两件工具。

shots.scene: 每只试剂瓶都连着一份空白文件
shots.prompt_en: A row of reagent bottles, each linked by a line to its own blank document. No people.
shots.narration: 每种化学品，都必须有一份SDS。

shots.scene: 旧文件夹上的标识变成新文件夹
shots.prompt_en: An old worn binder transforms into a new clean binder with a sparkle effect, both with blank covers. No people.
shots.narration: 它以前叫MSDS，现在统一叫SDS。

shots.scene: 空白文件四周浮现性质、危害、防护图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank document surrounded by three icons: a flask for properties, a warning triangle for hazards, and a shield for precautions. No people.
shots.narration: 性质、危害、防护，一份全能查到。

shots.scene: 老周指着书架上一排空白文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The older man points to a row of binders with blank spines on a shelf next to the chemical cabinet.
shots.narration: 先知道本实验室的SDS放在哪里。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻开文件夹认真阅读
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens a binder and reads a blank page carefully at the bench, wearing a lab coat.
shots.narration: 第一次用某种化学品，先读它的SDS。

shots.scene: 地球图标连接一份统一格式的文件
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon connected by arrows to one standard blank document with sixteen numbered blank strips. No people.
shots.narration: GHS是全球统一的分类和标签制度。

shots.scene: 文件展开成十六格
shots.prompt_en: A blank document unfolding into a grid of sixteen blank tiles. No people.
shots.narration: 按它的格式，SDS一律分成16部分。

shots.section_title: 第1–3部分：是什么、有何危险
shots.scene: 第一格高亮：瓶子和工厂图标
shots.prompt_en: The first blank tile lights up, showing a bottle icon and a small factory icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第1部分：化学品名称和生产商。
overlay: 第1–3部分：是什么、有何危险

shots.section_title: 第1–3部分：是什么、有何危险
shots.scene: 第二格高亮：菱形象形图和空白警示条
shots.prompt_en: The second tile lights up, showing a red diamond GHS pictogram and a blank warning strip. No people.
shots.narration: 第2部分：信号词、警示和象形图。

shots.section_title: 第1–3部分：是什么、有何危险
shots.scene: 第三格高亮：成分饼图
shots.prompt_en: The third tile lights up, showing a simple pie chart of ingredients. No people.
shots.narration: 第3部分：成分清单。

shots.scene: 第四格高亮：急救十字和冲洗图标
shots.prompt_en: The fourth tile lights up, showing a green first aid cross and a water rinsing icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第4部分：接触后怎么急救。

shots.scene: 第五格高亮：灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: The fifth tile lights up, showing a fire extinguisher icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第5部分：着火了怎么灭。

shots.scene: 第六格高亮：围堵溢洒的图标
shots.prompt_en: The sixth tile lights up, showing a small spill puddle surrounded by an absorbent ring. No people.
shots.narration: 第6部分：泄漏怎么围堵和清理。

shots.scene: 第七格高亮：试剂柜图标
shots.prompt_en: The seventh tile lights up, showing a closed storage cabinet icon and a hand holding a bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 第7部分：怎么操作、怎么储存。

shots.scene: 第八格高亮：护目镜、手套和通风柜图标
shots.prompt_en: The eighth tile lights up, showing goggles, gloves and a fume hood icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第8部分：接触限值和个人防护。

shots.scene: 第九格高亮：温度计、水滴、火苗图标
shots.prompt_en: The ninth tile lights up, showing a thermometer, a water droplet, a nose icon and a small flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第9部分：外观、气味、闪点等性质。

shots.scene: 第十格高亮：两瓶相遇被红叉隔开
shots.prompt_en: The tenth tile lights up, showing two bottles separated by a red X between them. No people.
shots.narration: 第10部分：怎样避免危险反应。

shots.scene: 第十一格高亮：人体轮廓和吸入、皮肤、口三条箭头
shots.prompt_en: The eleventh tile lights up, showing a human outline with three arrows toward the nose, skin and mouth. No people.
shots.narration: 第11部分：接触途径、症状和长短期影响。

shots.scene: 第十二到十五格依次高亮：树叶、垃圾桶、卡车、天平
shots.prompt_en: Tiles twelve to fifteen light up one by one, showing a leaf, a waste bin, a truck and a scale of justice icon. No people.
shots.narration: 后面是生态、废弃、运输、法规信息。

shots.scene: 第十六格高亮：日历图标
shots.prompt_en: The sixteenth tile lights up, showing a calendar icon with a refresh arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 第16部分可以查到编制和修订日期。

shots.scene: 小研举起一只试剂瓶，标签朝向镜头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a reagent bottle with the blank label facing the camera.
shots.narration: 了解化学品，还有一条途径：看标签。

shots.scene: 放大的空白标签上依次出现七个色块
shots.prompt_en: A large blank chemical label with seven empty colored blocks appearing one by one, and one red diamond GHS pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 标签上有七样东西缺一不可。

shots.scene: 标签下方两个色块高亮：急救和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Two more blocks at the bottom of the blank label light up: a first aid cross and a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有急救说明和供应商联系方式。

shots.scene: 一个GHS象形图放大：红菱形边框、白底、黑图形
shots.prompt_en: One large GHS hazard pictogram: a white diamond with a thick red border and a black flame symbol inside. No people.
shots.narration: 象形图：红色菱形框，白底黑图形。

shots.section_title: 象形图各代表什么危害
shots.scene: 健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: A GHS hazard pictogram with the black health hazard silhouette of a person with a star on the chest. No people.
shots.narration: 这个人形图，表示严重的健康危害。
overlay: 象形图各代表什么危害

shots.section_title: 象形图各代表什么危害
shots.scene: 火焰象形图
shots.prompt_en: A GHS hazard pictogram with a black flame symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 火焰，表示易燃。

shots.section_title: 象形图各代表什么危害
shots.scene: 感叹号象形图
shots.prompt_en: A GHS hazard pictogram with a black exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 感叹号，表示刺激、致敏等较轻危害。

shots.section_title: 象形图各代表什么危害
shots.scene: 气瓶象形图
shots.prompt_en: A GHS hazard pictogram with a black gas cylinder symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶，表示加压气体。

shots.section_title: 象形图各代表什么危害
shots.scene: 腐蚀象形图
shots.prompt_en: A GHS hazard pictogram with a black corrosion symbol of liquid dripping onto a hand and a bar. No people.
shots.narration: 腐蚀，会伤皮肤、伤眼睛、蚀金属。

shots.section_title: 象形图各代表什么危害
shots.scene: 爆炸弹象形图
shots.prompt_en: A GHS hazard pictogram with a black exploding bomb symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 爆炸弹，表示爆炸物或不稳定物质。

shots.section_title: 象形图各代表什么危害
shots.scene: 环境象形图和骷髅象形图并排
shots.prompt_en: Two GHS hazard pictograms side by side: a dead tree and fish for environment, and a skull and crossbones. No people.
shots.narration: 还有环境危害和急性毒性。

shots.scene: 圆圈上方火焰象形图
shots.prompt_en: A GHS hazard pictogram with a black flame over a circle symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 圆圈上方火焰，表示氧化性。

shots.scene: 氧化剂瓶放出氧气箭头，旁边纸张火苗变大
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle releasing small oxygen arrows toward a nearby burning paper whose flame grows bigger. No people.
shots.narration: 它能放出氧，引发或助长燃烧。

shots.scene: 氧化剂瓶和易燃溶剂瓶之间画红叉，分开两侧
shots.prompt_en: An oxidizer bottle icon and a flammable solvent bottle icon placed apart with a red X between them. No people.
shots.narration: 所以氧化剂要远离可燃物。

shots.section_title: 国内标准：中文SDS和中文标签
shots.scene: 王老师展示一本空白的中文规范手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows a blank standards handbook to two students in a training room.
shots.narration: 我国按GB 30000系列做分类和标签。
overlay: 国内标准：中文SDS和中文标签

shots.section_title: 国内标准：中文SDS和中文标签
shots.scene: 一份空白文件和一个空白标签并排，旁有对勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank document and a blank chemical label side by side, each with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: SDS和安全标签要有中文版。

shots.section_title: 信号词只有“危险”和“警告”
shots.scene: 两个空白标签：一个红色信号块，一个橙色信号块
shots.prompt_en: Two blank chemical labels side by side, one with a red signal block and one with an orange signal block. No people.
shots.narration: 信号词只有两个：危险和警告。
overlay: 信号词只有“危险”和“警告”

shots.scene: 九个GHS象形图排成三行
shots.prompt_en: Nine GHS hazard pictograms arranged in three rows of three, all with red diamond borders. No people.
shots.narration: GHS一共九个象形图，要全部认得。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着骷髅象形图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a GHS skull and crossbones hazard pictogram.
shots.narration: 骷髅图代表急性毒性，千万别忽略。

shots.section_title: 自配、分装的试剂也要贴标签
shots.scene: 小研在一只装好溶液的瓶子上贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sticks a blank label onto a bottle of freshly prepared solution, wearing goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 自己配的、分装的，也要贴标签。
overlay: 自配、分装的试剂也要贴标签

shots.section_title: 自配、分装的试剂也要贴标签
shots.scene: 无标签的瓶子和标签模糊的瓶子被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two bottles crossed out with a red X: one with no label and one with a smeared unreadable label. No people.
shots.narration: 没标签、看不清的，一律不用。

shots.section_title: 认出特殊管控的化学品
shots.scene: 试剂柜里几只瓶子带锁的图标
shots.prompt_en: A chemical cabinet with a few bottles marked by small padlock icons. No people.
shots.narration: 有些化学品国家另有专门管控。
overlay: 认出特殊管控的化学品

shots.section_title: 认出特殊管控的化学品
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白登记本，旁边是带锁的柜子
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank logbook next to a locked steel cabinet.
shots.narration: 采购、保管、领用都要按规定登记。

shots.section_title: 认出特殊管控的化学品
shots.scene: 小研查看SDS后去找王老师
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank binder, then walks over to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 查到属于这几类，先问清本校规定。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰对着打开的空白文件，旁边浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student read an open blank binder together, with four icons floating beside them: a warning triangle, a goggle, a first aid cross, a waste bin.
shots.narration: 看SDS，是为了实验前评估风险。

shots.scene: 两瓶不相容试剂被分开放
shots.prompt_en: Two reagent bottles moved to opposite ends of a shelf with a separation line between them. No people.
shots.narration: 查清不相容物，别让它们碰在一起。

shots.scene: 阿杰举着瓶子对照打开的SDS，点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds the reagent bottle next to an open blank binder and nods confidently.
shots.narration: 现在阿杰知道这瓶试剂的危害了。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向下一页空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a blank card with a right arrow on it.
shots.narration: 下一课，学习安全操作化学品。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现文件夹和试剂瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a blank binder and a labeled bottle.
shots.narration: SDS放哪要知道，首次使用先读。

shots.scene: 十六格文件图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank document icon with sixteen small tiles. No people.
shots.narration: 十六部分，急救泄漏防护都在里面。

shots.scene: 空白标签和九个小象形图
shots.prompt_en: A blank label icon next to nine small GHS hazard pictograms in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 标签七要素，九个象形图都认全。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的试剂柜旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy closed chemical cabinet.
shots.narration: 先识危害再动手，下次见！
